title: Elf Bar Dual 10K Blue Edition Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: Blue Edition Pre Filled Pods deliver bright, fruit-forward refreshment to the Elf Bar Dual 10K. One pod offers Blueberry Ice - a cool and mellow berry vape. The second brings fizzy Blue Razz Lemonade with a sweet and tangy citrus edge. Both pods feature built-in 5ml refills and are topped up automatically by the kit internal system. Blue Edition is a lively option for fans of cool and citrusy berry flavours. How to Use: 1. Remove the Sticker and Read the Instructions 2. Remove the Silicone Parts and the Bottom Sticker 3. Press both containers securely into place 4. Install the pod into the Dual 10K device to use
